policy._doc: What a release must have verified (docs/plan-release-validation.md; scripts/release-changes.ts). Each cause of change is drawn on its own, big changes likelier, until its guarantee holds: the error rate's upper bound below `tolerance` at `confidence`, with at most `allowed` errors found. Visible changes (names, addresses, places new or gone) allow none; the sun and footprints three — each error makes the draw grow until the bound holds again (46 cases with one error, 61 with two, 76 with three; the owner's decision, 2026-10-26, after the three sun causes blocked on two errors each in 46 cases: 4 % wrong, bound 13 %), and a fourth blocks. Tolerance 10 % (the owner's decision, 2026-10-22, after a first round of 60 cases: 29 cases per big cause, 46 for the sun and footprints). A wrong change the team corrected (its name, address, terrace or status set by the team) no longer blocks: it was OSM's error, fixed for that place; only uncorrected errors do.
